title.text: Consult engine — the doctor's screen as settings, not code

walk.text:
Walk board 1:
• My session drop-down: In / Out / Closed / Not started — the corridor display follows it.
• Call next → Start consult → Park: the line and the display update.
• Allergies: type in + Add allergy; suggestions appear. × removes.
• Complaint chips with ×; tap 'Your usual' to add. Diagnoses show ICD-10 · ICD-11.
• Suggested drugs show pharmacy stock. Add Amlong 5 (0 in stock): the right pane offers Stamlo 5. Use it or keep yours — both are recorded.
• TAPS counter is the speed instrument.

why.text:
Owner's five tests on every board: accuracy, speed, auditable, compliant, dashboard UX.

Comment on any board to rule on it.
